name: Buildhistory Diff
blurb: package and image size changes between two builds from buildhistory, largest first
intro: Compares two Yocto builds of one image from the files buildhistory writes (installed-package-sizes/info, installed-packages, files-in-image, image-info): which packages were added, removed, upgraded or grew, by how much, and which files moved. Formats and the 10% reporting threshold follow poky's buildhistory.bbclass and buildhistory_analysis.py.

usage: Pass `before` and `after` as the text of the same buildhistory file(s) from two builds (images/<machine>/<libc>/<image>/installed-package-info.txt is best: versions and sizes; installed-package-sizes.txt, installed-packages.txt, installed-package-names.txt and image-info.txt also read, one format per line), and optionally `filesBefore`/`filesAfter` as files-in-image.txt. It returns totals and the size change, counts of added/removed/upgraded/downgraded packages, a table of the largest changes with versions, the largest file changes, changed image-info variables, a buildhistory-diff style report text, and warnings for >10% growth, -dev/-dbg packages added, version downgrades, new setuid or world-writable files. Use `by: dirs` to compare two files-in-image.txt by directory, `focus` to get one package's matching files.
